note: Jackson County KY: 2022 county strategic plan says the county has no planning and zoning commission. McKee is the only city and publishes no zoning GIS layer; its code of ordinances has a land-usage title but no queryable district layer. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Jackson County KY zoning returned only Oregon and Missouri/Alabama Jackson County layers. The gis-jcgis zoning layer is Jackson County, Oregon.
